title: pseva japonica
intro: Pseva japonica, commonly known as Japanese skullcap, is a plant species in the mint family that is native to East Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat a range of health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pseva japonica include sedative and anti-anxiety effects, which have been attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Pseva japonica have been found to have neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory effects, which may contribute to its potential therapeutic benefits.
